overview: DeepWeightFlow implements a Flow Matching generative model operating directly in neural network weight space, utilizing canonicalization (Git Re-Basin/TransFusion) to resolve permutation symmetries and PCA for scaling, to efficiently generate complete, high-performing neural network weights without fine-tuning.

modules.name: Target Training Dataset Generator
modules.description: Trains a collection of neural networks independently from random initialization on various target tasks (vision, tabular, NLP) to construct the diverse dataset of weight vectors required to train the generative model.

modules.name: Weight Flattening and Canonicalization
modules.description: Extracts and flattens model parameters into 1D vectors. Applies Git Re-Basin for CNNs/MLPs or TransFusion for Transformers to align weights to a single reference basin, resolving permutation symmetries to simplify the weight space distribution.

modules.name: Scalable Dimensionality Reduction (PCA)
modules.description: Implements Incremental PCA for moderate-dimensional weights and Dual PCA (Gram matrix method) for high-dimensional weights (e.g., BERT) to reduce memory constraints, with corresponding inverse transformation logic for weight reconstruction.

modules.name: Flow Matching Network Architecture
modules.description: Constructs the time-conditioned MLP architecture with layer normalization, GELU activations, and a learnable time embedding module, designed to predict the velocity vector in the flattened (or PCA-reduced) weight space.

modules.name: Flow Matching Training Engine
modules.description: Implements the training loop for the flow model, computing the straight-line interpolation trajectory between source noise and target weights, and optimizing the velocity prediction loss against the ground truth vector field.

modules.name: ODE-based Weight Sampling
modules.description: Implements the generation pipeline that samples noise from the source distribution and integrates the learned velocity field using a 4th-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) ODE solver to produce novel weight configurations.

modules.name: Weight Reconstruction and Calibration
modules.description: Reconstructs full-dimensional weights from latent representations (inverse PCA), injects the flattened vectors back into the target neural network architecture, and performs Batch Normalization running statistics recalibration.

modules.name: Downstream Task Evaluation
modules.description: Evaluates the functional performance of the generated neural networks on held-out test sets, computing metrics such as classification accuracy for vision tasks and Spearman correlation for regression tasks.

modules.name: Diversity and Distance Metrics
modules.description: Computes quantitative measures of generative diversity, including maximum Intersection over Union (mIoU) of error sets, Jensen-Shannon divergence, Wasserstein distance, and cosine similarity between generated and original weights.

modules.name: Canonicalization Impact Analysis
modules.description: Ablation study framework to evaluate the effect of weight canonicalization on flow model performance across varying model capacities, determining when alignment benefits generation versus when model capacity suffices.

modules.name: Transfer Learning Pipeline
modules.description: Assesses the generalization capability of generated weights by evaluating zero-shot performance and fine-tuning efficiency on unseen datasets (e.g., STL-10, SVHN) compared to pretrained and randomly initialized baselines.

modules.name: Computational Efficiency Benchmarking
modules.description: Profiles and compares the training duration, generation time per sample, and resource consumption of the Flow Matching approach against diffusion-based baselines (RPG, P-diff) to validate efficiency claims.
